title: ExtractionProposal
description: What `ai` proposes after reading a document. A proposal is advisory only: `api` validates it and decides whether anything is posted. Nothing here is trusted.

document_id.description: The `api`-side document this proposal is about; echoed back from the request.

vendor.description: Vendor name as read off the document. Absent when it could not be read.

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code. `api` rejects any code outside its own allowed set.

total_minor.description: Document total in minor units. Integer, never a float — see architecture C1. Negative for a credit note or refund.

tax_minor.description: Tax portion in minor units, already included in `total_minor`. Negative when total_minor is negative (a refunded tax), never negative on its own.

document_date.description: Date printed on the document (not the upload date).

lines.description: Line items. May be empty when the document has no itemisation; `api` decides whether that is acceptable.

confidence.description: Per-field confidence in [0,1]. Every extracted field carries one.

model.description: Which model produced this. `fake-llm-v1` is the M4 stub; a real adapter arrives at M5.

warnings.description: Non-fatal notes from the extractor, for a human reviewer.

confidenceScore.description: A confidence in [0,1]. This is the one place a non-integer is legal — it is not money.

quantity.description: Quantity in thousandths, so 1.5 units is 1500. Integer for the same reason amounts are.

amount_minor.description: Line total in minor units. Integer, never a float.
